method: Every window below was set by extracting frames from the named file and looking at them. Nothing is carried over from a shot list or inferred from a filename.

S01.what: Travion Thompson in a red shirt, one continuous take, standing in the street outside the complex. Apartments, parked cars and a blue recycling bin behind him.
S01.note: A talking head for its whole length: he is the one speaking, so it is a sound-bite source only. Never scenery.

S02.what: ABC13 package: a developing-story card, an anchor, a Houston map with a playground pin and a Brays Bayou pin, then street shots by the complex - a woman by police tape, patrol cars, searchers in tall grass, a playground, Travion in the street, neighbours. From 110 s it is Bill Barajas standing in front of the bayou.
S02.note: The anchor (0-11 s), the map (11-21 s) and the reporter stand-up (110 s on) are not b-roll. Everything else on the street is usable.

S03.what: Chief Art Acevedo, continuous press conference, police tape and greenery behind him.
S03.note: One press-conference setup for the whole 831 s. He is a named person speaking, so this is useable only when he is the person being shown or quoted. There is no crowd, no police car and no neighbourhood in this file.

S04.what: Sunset Crossing Apartments: Maliyah stills (0-15 s), a Beechnut and Westcrest map (16-24 s), a reporter stand-up (26-45 s), then the real place - brick walkways, AC units, external stairs, a ground-floor window, the parking court, and two playground sets (46-124 s).
S04.note: The apartment exteriors start at 46 s, not at 4 s. The first 15 s is two Maliyah photographs with baked-in blur, and 26-45 s is Taisha Walker on camera. Ends on an ABC13 card at 140 s.

S05.what: Memorial and vigil: a family in purple behind police tape (0-6 s), a crowd in pink Justice for Maliyah Bass shirts (16-19 s), a memorial of soft toys, balloons and a portrait (19-25 s), the playground behind rows of chairs (40-41 s), a walkway with neighbours (41-47 s), a Texas EquuSearch command centre sign (72-74 s), an open field with search vehicles (75-80 s), a crowd in pink and a woman being consoled (82-99 s).
S05.note: 6-14 s is an unrelated studio interview and 47-71 s is a speaker addressing the crowd - neither is b-roll.

S06.what: Maliyah playing in a red top and a grey romper (1.5-19 s, 100-110 s), exterior stairs and a balcony (19-21 s), low apartment blocks across a lawn (60-64 s), the bayou and a path with searchers (80-88 s), apartment blocks at dusk (90-95 s).
S06.note: The child footage is the only moving picture of Maliyah. From 110 s it is a reporter and then a KHOU app promo.

S07.what: Maliyah playing and at a railing (6-20 s), Sahara Erving on the stairs in a mask (66-76 s, 118-134 s), the two accused in a split screen (78-84 s), Travion Thompson in a red shirt by parked cars (88-96 s), a woman by a black car (112-116 s), Andy Kahan (136-152 s).
S07.note: 25-62 s and 168 s on are Taisha Walker on camera - not b-roll. The two-accused split screen is a graphic, not a place.

S08.what: A marked police unit on a night street (0-11 s), a courtroom gallery (36-38 s), a dispatch desk and a console operator (40-47 s), a Justice For poster (49-51 s), an apartment complex at dusk with a police SUV in the lot (51-53 s), a path with a green sign (53.5-56.5 s), HPD officers detaining a man by a brick wall (60.5-64.5 s), apartment buildings in daylight (65-67.5 s), searchers in yellow vests on a path (71-76 s).
S08.note: The night reporter in the red dress (13-30 s, 82 s on) is a field reporter and may not appear. This file is the richest b-roll in the set after S10 and the old inventory called it a reporter stand-up.

S09.what: An anchor (0-14 s), a reporter on a city street (15-57 s), deputies escorting a man in an orange jumpsuit (58-60 s), a Harris County patrol car with a crowd behind (61-63.5 s), a man in orange at an intake counter (64-70 s), a courtroom with a judge at the bench (71-73.5 s).
S09.note: 180 s long, not 9.5 s. The old inventory stopped at a card that is not there. The reporter stretches (15-57 s, 140-175 s) may not appear; the jail and court shots at 58-73.5 s are the only courthouse picture in the whole set.

S10.what: The flood, start to finish, with no presenter and no lower third: flooded street, apartment block behind a fence, a submerged stop sign, debris, the roadway under water, two searchers in rain jackets, a flooded underpass with a car, a barricaded road, bridge supports in the water, fast water, a low bridge, a brick apartment block in the flood, a spillway.
S10.note: The best b-roll in the set and the only source that is b-roll for its entire length. Thirteen distinct shots, none of them reused.
